nodes.label: Laravel Reverb — Configuración y despliegue
nodes.rationale: Separates REVERB_SERVER_* (where the binary listens) from REVERB_HOST/PORT/SCHEME (how Laravel and the browser reach it) so reverse proxies and TLS termination can differ from the internal socket.

nodes.label: Tablas — DaisyUI vs PrimeVue DataTable
nodes.rationale: DaisyUI tables chosen for ≤50 static rows (zero JS) and PrimeVue DataTable for large/filterable/sortable datasets, with server-side pagination when data does not fit in memory.

nodes.label: Migración a Tailwind CSS v4 + DaisyUI v5
nodes.norm_label: migracion a tailwind css v4 + daisyui v5
nodes.rationale: Configuration moved from tailwind.config.js into app.css and postcss.config.js removed because @tailwindcss/vite handles processing, avoiding the @layer base conflict.

nodes.label: MessengerGatewayInterface
nodes.rationale: Decouples the chat flow from Baileys/Evolution so a Meta Cloud API adapter can be bound in AppServiceProvider without rewriting the orchestrator.

nodes.label: Booking Stage State Machine (RECEPTION→COMPLETED)
nodes.rationale: Stage machine plus anti-amnesia blocks (saved/missing fields) exist because the short LLM history caused the model to re-ask for name and service after multiple tool calls.

nodes.label: Arquitectura WhatsApp Booking + Telegram Admin + Perfiles
nodes.norm_label: arquitectura whatsapp booking + telegram admin + perfiles
nodes.rationale: Instance profiles share one Evolution session; business policies live in instance data (not hardcoded orchestrator rules) and concurrency mitigations (Redis lock, debounce, soft-hold) exist because Evolution delivers bursts in parallel.
